description: Land Title Settlement Department - Pitipana South, Homagama D/S Division, Colombo District - Cad. Map No. 520007 (7603)
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration amendments under the Registration of Title Act. It contains multiple entries detailing specific amendments to land parcel records, including changes to land extent measurements, insertion of servitude rights, mortgage particulars, and ownership details for specific land parcels identified by cadastral map numbers and block numbers. The content falls squarely within the Land Gazette category as it concerns land registrations, property ownership records, and title amendments.
